reviews.text: Chris did a new block front porch,sidewalks and a retaining wall for us. His work was impeccable. His attention to detail from start to finish was awesome. He went above and beyond with this job and I highly recommend him.
reviews.author: Al T.

reviews.text: Chris did an excellent job with our front sidewalk of our house. He worked through intense heat to get our sidewalk done. One year later, our sidewalk still looks brand new and adds curb appeal to our house. Thank you, Chris.
reviews.author: Robert B.

reviews.text: Chris did a Tremendous Job on my Wife's patio. He had a Very Long Day finishing the patio multiple times due to weather. He made it look perfect. I Highly Recommend Rogan Masonry!!
reviews.author: John M.
